start: Menu, Money, Expenses, a gym with receipts this month

user_sees: Title 'Expenses' and 'What went out, and what the gym kept'
This month's name with 'This month' under it
Three tiles: 'Collected', 'Expenses', 'Profit'
must_not: A voided receipt counted in 'Collected'
NaN or a blank in a tile

steps.action: Tap '+ Add expense', type 12000, pick the category Rent, keep today's date, save
user_sees: Toast 'Expense added.'
A row 'Rent' with the day and the amount
'By category' shows Rent with a bar
must_not: Two rows from one save
The expense landing in another month

user_sees: 'Expenses' went up by 12,000 and 'Profit' went down by the same
When shop orders were handed over this month: 'Fees … + shop …' under Collected
must_not: Profit not equal to Collected minus Expenses
A different month total than the Money screen shows

user_sees: Last month's name and a link 'Back to this month'
Last month's rows and totals
must_not: This month's expense shown in last month
The '›' arrow going past this month

steps.action: Tap 'Add expense' among the quick actions
user_sees: The Expenses screen opens
must_not: Another screen, or a blank page

steps.action: Add an expense as in the normal way
user_sees: Toast 'Expense added.' and the new row
must_not: The expense missing after going back to Today

start: AI Assistant, the owner asks it to add an expense

steps.action: Ask the assistant to note an expense and confirm its card
user_sees: The words 'Expense saved.' and a way to open Expenses
must_not: An expense saved before the owner confirmed
A second expense when the card is confirmed twice

user_sees: The expense is in the right month with the amount and category asked for
must_not: A different amount or category than the card showed

steps.action: Leave the amount empty and save
user_sees: 'Type how much was spent.'
must_not: An expense of zero saved

steps.action: Type letters in the amount and save
user_sees: 'That amount looks wrong. Type it again.'
must_not: The sheet closing

user_sees: 'Type an amount more than zero.'
must_not: A zero row in the list

user_sees: 'The expense date can’t be in the future.'
must_not: An expense dated in the future counted in this month

steps.action: Sign in as front-desk staff and look for Expenses
user_sees: No Expenses row in the menu; the address /expenses does not open the screen
must_not: Staff seeing expenses or profit
A greyed-out Expenses row

start: Expenses, one expense saved this month

user_sees: Sheet 'Remove this expense?' with the amount, the category, the day and '… will be removed for good. You can’t get it back. You would have to add it again.'
Buttons 'Keep it' and 'Remove'
must_not: The expense removed before the owner confirms

user_sees: The row is still there
must_not: A changed total

user_sees: Toast 'Expense removed.'
Expenses and Profit go back to what they were
With no rows left: 'No expenses this month' and 'Add rent, salaries, electricity and the rest to see what the gym really kept.'
must_not: The removed expense still inside the month total
It coming back after a refresh

steps.action: Add an expense dated in last month
user_sees: The screen moves to last month and shows the new row
must_not: The screen staying on this month so the owner thinks nothing was saved

start: A gym with an owner and one front-desk staff person, both signed in

steps.action: Owner adds an expense; staff refreshes their panel
user_sees: Staff see no Expenses page, no profit and no expense rows anywhere
must_not: Expense amounts or profit on a staff screen
A staff sign-in able to save or remove an expense

steps.action: Owner downloads the gym's data in Settings
user_sees: The Expenses sheet lists every expense with date, amount, category and note
must_not: Another gym's expenses in the file
